problem_statement: The digital microphone (PDM/DMIC) API cannot be configured from devicetree. There is no way to build a pdm_io_cfg from a devicetree node describing the microphone's allowable PDM clock frequency and duty-cycle ranges, and no way to query from devicetree which PDM channels (left/right) a microphone provides. A devicetree node using compatible "zephyr,pdm-dmic" with properties clk-frequency-min, clk-frequency-max, clk-duty-cycle-min, clk-duty-cycle-max, channel-left and channel-right should be usable to construct a pdm_io_cfg and to test the presence of left/right channels.
